email.subject: Ironside Pros: a couple of quick fixes
email.body:
Hi Nora,

I looked at Ironside Pros Auto Care's site. Two things are likely costing you booked jobs: there's no click-to-call link, so mobile visitors can't tap to call you, and there's no booking option, so anyone ready to schedule has to call during business hours or leave. The site also isn't optimized for mobile, which is where most local searches happen.

I fix these for a flat fee, no retainer. Want a free 10-minute walkthrough where I show you exactly what's happening and what it'd take to fix?

Alex
Northlight Web
